div.head: Swer 1
div.ab: Hu se man sceal swerie. On ðone Drihten, þe ðes haligdom is fore halig, ic wille beon N. hold ⁊ getriwe ⁊ eal lufian ðæt he lufað ⁊ eal ascunian ðæt he ascunað, æfter Godes rihte ⁊ æfter woroldgerysnum, ⁊ næfre willes ne gewealdes, wordes ne weorces owiht don ðæs him laðre bið, wið þam ðe he me healde, swa ic earnian wille, ⁊ eall þæt læste, þæt uncer formæl wæs, þa ic to him gebeah ⁊ his willan geceas.

Ðus man sceal swerigean hyldaðas. On ðone Drihten, ðe ðæs halidom is fore halig, ic wylle beon Ñ hold ⁊ getrywe ⁊ eal lufian þæt he lufað ⁊ eal ascunian þæt he ascunoð, æfter Godes rihte ⁊ æfter woroldgerysnum, ⁊ næfre willes ne gewealdes, wordes ne weorces owiht don þæs him ladre bið, wið ðam ðe he me healde, swa ic earnian wille, ⁊ eal þæt læste, þæt uncer formæl wæs, ða ic to him gebeah ⁊ his willan geceas.

Iuramenta legitima fidelitatis, repetitionis, adlegiationis. (De iuramentis.) In illo Deo, pro quo sanctum hoc sanctificatum est, uolo esse domino meo N. fidelis et credibilis et amare quod amet et absoniare quod absoniet, per Dei rectum et seculi competentiam, et nunquam ex uelle uel posse, uerbo uel opere quicquam facere, quod ei magis displiceat, ut me teneat, sicut deseruire uolo, et totum mihi compleat, quod in nostra prelocutione fuit, quando suus deueni et eius elegi uoluntatem.

(Wie der Vasall schwören soll. H. Folgendermassen soll man Huldigungseid[e?] schwören. B) Bei dem Herrn, vor welchem dies Heiligthum heilig ist, ich will N. treu und vertrauenswerth sein und alles lieben, was er liebt und alles verabscheuen, was er verabscheut, gemäss religiöser Pflicht und gemäss bürgerlichen Rechtsgewohnheiten, und niemals mit Willen oder Absicht, in Wort oder Werk etwas dávon thun was ihm verhasster ist, gegen dén Beding, dass er mich halte wie ich verdienen werde, und alles das leiste, was unsere Verabredung war, da ich mich ihm unterwarf und seinen Willen erkor.

(How the vassal shall swear. H. Thus shall one swear oath[s?] of fealty. B) By the Lord before whom this relic is holy, I will be faithful and true to N. and love all that he loves and shun all that he shuns, according to God's law and according to secular custom, and never, willingly or intentionally, in word or deed, do anything that is more hateful to him, on condition that he keep me as I shall deserve, and fulfil all that was our agreement when I submitted to him and chose his will.

How one should take an oath. [I swear] by the Lord before whom this relic is holy, [that] I will be faithful and true to N., and love all he loves and hate all he hates, in accordance with God’s law and the world’s proper practice, and will not intentionally do anything in word or deed that is abhorrent to him, on the understanding that he will keep me as I deserve, [while] all that lasts that was in our agreement when I submitted to him and chose [to follow] his will.

Liebermann dates the collection c. 920–c. 1050; individual formulae may be older: formula 1 is used at least in part in II Ew 1.1 (compare III Em 1, I Cn 20), but ‘formæl’ is borrowed from the North, so after 900. note.seg: Ich nenne das Stück aus der Überschrift Swerian, da Að ein anderes Stück o. I 464 heisst
I call the piece Swerian from its heading, since another piece, above I 464, is called Að

Allgemeine Überschrift fehlt B. Die H's ist zwar mit der in Q nicht verwandt (welche laut des abstrakten Charakters diesem juristisch-kanonistisch geschulten Lateiner eher als einem Angelsachsen um 1000 zu gehören scheint), wohl aber formell mit denen von Wer und Wif in B. Diese drei Stücke stehen in HBQ. Es liegt also nahe, eine allgemeine Überschrift dem Archetyp zuzuschreiben, etwa der Form: Hu man sceal swerian, um so mehr, als B diese Form vor 8 bringt. Die Sonderaufschrift von 1: þus (oder hu) se man sceal swerian hyldaðas bei H hätte dann, durch Vorsetzung des Artikels, aus dem Indefinitum den Vassallen gemacht; in B wäre hu in ðus, d. i. die den folgenden Einzelkapiteln entsprechende Form, geändert worden, und so in beiden die Allgemein-Überschrift in der ihr ähnlichen zum ersten Kapitel untergegangen

The general heading is missing in B. That of H is indeed not related to the one in Q (which, given its abstract character, seems to belong to this Latinist trained in law and canon law rather than to an Anglo-Saxon c. 1000), but it is formally related to those of Wer and Wif in B. These three pieces stand in HBQ. It is therefore natural to ascribe a general heading to the archetype, perhaps of the form Hu man sceal swerian, all the more as B gives this form before 8. The special heading of 1 in H, þus (or hu) se man sceal swerian hyldaðas, would then, by prefixing the article, have turned the indefinite pronoun into the vassal; in B, hu would have been changed to ðus, i.e. the form corresponding to the individual chapters that follow; and so in both the general heading would have been lost in the similar heading of the first chapter
Die Editoren verstehen se man indefinitiv ‘man’, was nicht angeht, obwohl es der Sinn B's und wahrscheinlich laut vor. Erkl. der einstigen Archetyp-Überschrift war
The editors take se man indefinitely as ‘one’, which is not admissible, although it was the sense of B and probably, according to the preceding note, that of the original heading of the archetype

Der Plural hat auch sonst singularen Sinn; vgl. Ann. Agsax. 874. 878. 1016. 1086.—Sachlich vgl. Gl Mannschaftseid 2ff.; Gefolgsadel 12. Der Eid verrät keinerlei territoriale Beziehung, die zum Lehnwesen (s. d. Gl 3 I; læn 4h) überleitete, wie das unter Oswald von Worcester vorkommt. Ein chronologisches Merkmal folgt aber daraus nicht; jene genetisch frühere Form mochte neben dieser späteren fortbestehen

The plural has singular sense elsewhere too; cf. Ann. Agsax. 874. 878. 1016. 1086.—On the substance cf. Gl Mannschaftseid 2ff.; Gefolgsadel 12. The oath betrays no territorial connection whatever such as would lead over to feudalism (see that word in Gl 3 I; læn 4h), as occurs under Oswald of Worcester. No chronological criterion follows from this, however; that genetically earlier form may have continued alongside this later one
